description.value:
武器（任意弹药），非普通

这只水蛭被风干已久，其中蕴含着一股活化的魔力。如果你用这种弹药发动的远程武器攻击击中了一个生物，水蛭将复活并立刻将它的牙齿嵌在目标身上，之后，每个目标的回合开始时水蛭将对其造成[[/damage 1d4 type=piercing]]伤害。如果这只水蛭合计造成了10点或更多伤害、或它的目标死亡，它将自动掉落下来。生物（包括目标自己）也可以用自己的动作来拔下水蛭。

一旦水蛭离开它的目标，它就会再度死亡并不再具有魔法。

This leech has been dried and imbued with a mote of animating magic. If you hit a creature with a ranged attack roll using this ammunition, the leech springs to life and sinks its teeth into the target, dealing [[/damage 1d4 type=piercing]] damage at the start of each of the target's turns. If the leech deals at least 10 damage or the target dies, the leech falls off. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the leech. Once a leech is no longer attached to its target, the leech dies and is no longer magical.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Arrow|PHB] (@item[Dried Leech Arrow|BMT])
  • @item[Blowgun Needle|PHB] (@item[Dried Leech Blowgun Needle|BMT])
  • @item[Crossbow Bolt|PHB] (@item[Dried Leech Crossbow Bolt|BMT])
  • @item[Modern Bullet|DMG] (@item[Dried Leech Modern Bullet|BMT])
  • @item[Renaissance Bullet|DMG] (@item[Dried Leech Renaissance Bullet|BMT])
  • @item[Sling Bullet|PHB] (@item[Dried Leech Sling Bullet|BMT])
